access_window_utc.note: Bounded review interval from observed UTC clock readings; per-request browser timestamps were not exposed.

method: Read-only primary documentation, standards, upstream code/test definitions, release notes and official preservation guidance. No downloads or code execution.

sources.title: ffprobe documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Current moving upstream documentation; no tagged release is identified on the page. The investigator pairs it with FFmpeg 9.0.2, but the documentation URL itself is unpinned.
sources.observed_operation: Opened and checked the probe output and optional-field documentation.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: JSON/XML omit invalid or non-applicable fields when optional-field behavior is auto, the documented default. ffprobe returns a positive exit code if input cannot be opened or recognized.
sources.applicability: Supports keeping omitted values unknown and separating probe failure from later preview. Qualify the actual pinned binary.

sources.title: FFmpeg command-line documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Current moving manual; no release tag in URL. FFmpeg 9.0.2 is the investigator's separate release baseline.
sources.locator: §4.1.1 Automatic stream selection; §4.1.2 Manual stream selection.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official manual and checked the selection rule.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Without explicit mapping, audio selection favors the stream with the most channels; ties select the lowest stream index. -map restricts output to mapped streams, subject to the documented filtergraph exception.
sources.applicability: Supports explicit stream selection for multi-speaker review; not a guarantee that every build can decode a chosen stream.

sources.title: FFmpeg audio filter documentation
sources.version_or_commit: FFmpeg tag n9.0.2; release-pinned source documentation.
sources.locator: Audio Filters, channelsplit (§ around source lines 4090–4101) and pan (§ around 5722–5783).
sources.observed_operation: Opened the tag-pinned raw source and checked channel layout, absent-channel behavior and pure mapping conditions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: channelsplit defaults its input layout to stereo, defaults channels to all, and errors when requested channels are absent from that layout. pan is described as pure/lossless mapping only with zero/one gains and one input per output.
sources.applicability: Supports explicit layout/index confirmation and avoiding default downmix or speaker labels. Build inclusion still depends on configured filters.

sources.title: FFmpeg FATE ffprobe tests
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The tests generate a known fixture and exercise multiple output modes including JSON; the test target is conditional on configured components and is not proof a custom package ran it.
sources.applicability: Supports proposing structured-output fixture tests while keeping execution status explicitly false.

sources.title: Symphonia 0.6.1 feature manifest and crate docs
sources.version_or_commit: Symphonia tag v0.6.1; versioned source file.
sources.locator: [features], default, all-codecs, all-formats; docs.rs crate 0.6.1 support page.
sources.observed_operation: Read the pinned Cargo feature manifest and crate landing page.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Default features list opt-simd, metadata, ADPCM, FLAC, MKV, OGG, PCM, Vorbis and WAV. AAC, ALAC, MP3-family, AIFF, CAF and ISO-MP4 require optional feature flags. The all-features docs build is not the default runtime configuration.
sources.applicability: Supports pinning and testing the exact application feature set. Opus adapter is separate integration, not native default support.

sources.title: Symphonia getting-started caller
sources.version_or_commit: Symphonia tag v0.6.1; page identifies release commit ee35874.
sources.observed_operation: Read the pinned upstream example code.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The example hints with an extension, chooses a default audio track, uses expect/panic for some errors, and skips certain decode errors.
sources.applicability: Supports treating the example as an integration sketch, not production error policy or museum speaker assignment.

sources.title: Symphonia 0.6.1 release notes
sources.version_or_commit: Tag v0.6.1; displayed short commit ee35874; release page displays Aug 13 without a year.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Notes include MP3 silent-section and CRC-tag fixes, mono MP1, large metadata/attachment performance, malformed-input memory hardening and fuzz-found panics. These are corrected cases, not universal support guarantees.
sources.applicability: Supports regression-corpus and upgrade review; do not claim all formats/files are safe.

sources.title: Symphonia regression-pack discussion
sources.locator: Maintainer response on personal-library testing; differing timestamps/durations; reproducible rights-cleared fixtures.
sources.observed_operation: Read the primary project discussion and maintainer reply.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Maintainer describes private-library regression testing as not reproducible due to copyright/size and notes different duration/PTS behavior among tools. This is discussion evidence, not a support guarantee.
sources.applicability: Supports retaining duration provenance and proposing cleared, reproducible fixtures.

sources.title: GstDiscoverer API
sources.version_or_commit: Current moving upstream API documentation with per-API Since annotations; no single release pinned.
sources.locator: GstDiscovererResult enum; duration API; blocking/asynchronous discovery.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the API documentation and checked the result enum.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Result states distinguish OK, invalid URI, error, timeout, busy and missing plugins; duration is nanoseconds; async use needs a running GLib main context/loop.
sources.applicability: Supports explicit discovery states where plugin/runtime deployment is viable.

sources.title: GStreamer missing-plugin design
sources.version_or_commit: Current upstream design page; API note references core/base-utils >= 0.10.12; no current release pin.
sources.locator: Missing URI handler, typefind, demuxer and decoder discussion; application policy.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Plugin absence is reported to the application; installation behavior is application policy. Partial plugin sets can allow partial discovery/playback.
sources.applicability: Supports surfacing qualified missing-preview states and never auto-installing a plugin as an intake side effect.

sources.title: RFC 8493 BagIt File Packaging Format
sources.observed_operation: Read the standard's payload and checksum requirements.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Payload manifest lists each payload file exactly once with checksum and base-relative path; BagIt gives corruption/transfer integrity but is not designed against active attacks.
sources.applicability: Supports self-contained portable handoff and checksum validation; it does not supply catalog or rights semantics.

sources.title: SQLite transaction documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Current moving SQLite documentation; no API/runtime version captured.
sources.locator: Read versus write transactions; DEFERRED/IMMEDIATE behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Multiple concurrent readers are allowed, with only one simultaneous write transaction. Write-upgrade conflicts can produce SQLITE_BUSY.
sources.applicability: Supports serial checkpoint writes and explicit busy/recovery tests if SQLite is chosen.

sources.title: Atomic Commit In SQLite
sources.version_or_commit: Current moving SQLite documentation; article describes rollback-journal behavior; WAL uses a different mechanism.
sources.locator: §§3.7–3.11 commit sequence; stated storage and flush assumptions.
sources.observed_operation: Read the official commit explanation and conditions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Atomicity depends on database journaling, flushes and storage/VFS/hardware assumptions. It does not imply an atomic transaction across the application database and separately copied package files.
sources.applicability: Supports MI-01 and the draft's own caveat about cross-filesystem/database recovery.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Recommendation
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Keyboard SC has a path-dependent-input exception. Status Messages says content implemented using markup languages must expose programmatically determinable status without focus.
sources.applicability: Supports user-flow acceptance criteria; a native UI still needs platform accessibility semantics and screen-reader verification.

sources.title: DROID repository README
sources.version_or_commit: develop branch pointer observed; full branch HEAD SHA not exposed in this review. Latest visible release 6.9.13 is a separate pin; its release page states 18 commits to develop since that release.
sources.locator: General Information; CLI and CSV output; managing binary/container signature-file versions.
sources.observed_operation: Read the official DROID repository README and signature CLI examples.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: DROID uses versioned internal signatures, can update/switch those files, and emits CSV. A moving develop branch is not a reproducible code identity.
sources.applicability: Supports optional format identification and recording binary/container signature versions; supports MIN-02.

sources.title: The National Archives DROID/PRONOM role guidance
sources.version_or_commit: Current official page; revision not displayed.
sources.locator: DROID identification description and PRONOM signature coverage paragraph.
sources.observed_operation: Read the official guidance page via search result after direct open failed.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The page says identification may use extension or internal signature and states around 70 percent of PRONOM entries currently have signatures; internal signatures are described as more accurate than extensions.
sources.applicability: Confirms DROID coverage limitation; the percentage is mutable and not an audio-decoding guarantee.

sources.title: FFmpeg downloads and release source
sources.version_or_commit: FFmpeg 9.0.2 source listed on the official download page at access time.
sources.locator: Download Source Code; compiled package links; release verification.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Upstream provides source; compiled builds are linked from external packagers. Exact configured build and enabled components therefore matter.
sources.applicability: Supports qualification of the exact shipped artifact, not inference from an upstream release number alone.

sources.title: FFmpeg License and Legal Considerations
sources.version_or_commit: Current moving upstream licensing guidance; no package configuration is evaluated.
sources.locator: FFmpeg License and LGPL compliance checklist.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Licensing depends on enabled GPL/nonfree options, linkage and redistribution facts. Page guidance is not a legal determination for a proposed bundle.
sources.applicability: Supports the draft's exact-build/distribution review condition and no legal sign-off claim.
